description: This Java source file defines the class EncodedStringValue, which represents an encoded string with associated character set information. It includes constructors, getters, setters, and utility methods for manipulating encoded string data in the context of the Android MMS library.

classes.name: EncodedStringValue
classes.description: Represents an encoded string with a specific character set, providing methods for encoding, decoding, cloning, splitting, concatenating, and manipulating the encoded string data.

methods.name: EncodedStringValue
methods.description: Constructs an EncodedStringValue with specified charset and data.

methods.name: EncodedStringValue
methods.description: Constructs an EncodedStringValue with data and default charset.

methods.name: EncodedStringValue
methods.description: Constructs an EncodedStringValue from a string, encoding it using default charset.

methods.name: getTextString
methods.description: Returns a copy of the text byte array.

methods.name: setTextString
methods.description: Sets the text byte array, enforcing non-null.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Decodes the byte array into a string using the charset.

methods.name: appendTextString
methods.description: Appends additional bytes to the existing text data.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the EncodedStringValue instance.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the encoded string around a pattern and returns an array of EncodedStringValue.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts an array of EncodedStringValue objects from a semicolon-separated string.

methods.name: concat
methods.description: Concatenates an array of EncodedStringValue into a single string separated by semicolons.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a given EncodedStringValue.

methods.name: encodeStrings
methods.description: Encodes an array of Strings into an array of EncodedStringValue.
